## History

Rogerson was a middle-aged lady who had taught a Sunday-school class for twenty years. She taught the Sunday-school class that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attended alone, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ultimately found to be a dull experience.
